records.verbatim: the project will involve up to $25 billion in investment at full scale
records.notes: Company first-party (Sur Energy). The release states an LOI and a capacity ceiling but no construction timeline, and does not mention Patagonia. OpenAI's own release (openai.com) returned 403, so the OpenAI side is unverified. The round-1 lead asked whether the investment is committed; the release says 'up to' at full scale, which is not a commitment. No RIGI approval is shown.

records.notes: Timeline claim by the executive. A year on, no construction start has been confirmed in this run's searches, so treat as stale until checked.

fields.source_title: SEA response to Cerrillos (via CPI Chile repost of Diario Financiero)

records.verbatim: no se generarán impactos adversos significativos

translation.text: no significant adverse impacts will be generated

records.notes: SEA's 2021 response to the municipality's appeal, quoted by a reprint. The 2024 Segundo Tribunal Ambiental ruling later partly annulled that approval (see round-1 record CL-3). This is the regulator's position at the time, not a current finding. Stance is editorial and set to positive as a regulator's no-impact finding; curator to confirm. Verbatim is on the reprint, which cites the Diario Financiero original of 2021-01-20; the original was not fetched.

records.verbatim: Establecer que dicho documento se entenderá vigente desde la fecha de publicación

translation.text: Establish that said document shall be understood to be in force from the date of publication

records.notes: Primary regulator document: SEA guidance 'Criterio de evaluación en el SEIA: Introducción a proyectos de Data Center' (first edition, 2026). It describes the parts, works and impacts of data centres and the conditions under which they must enter the SEIA; that scope is not quoted here. The SEA index page gives 25 Feb 2026 as the observance start; the PDF says in force from publication of the Diario Oficial extract. Law firm summaries disagree on thresholds (JDF: 80,000 kg flammable storage; Carey: 3 MW generators, 23 kV lines over 2 km, 1,000 t storage) and are NOT used here. Case-by-case assessment applies, with no express SEIA typology for data centres.
